creative_brief_summary.hero: Own a Piece of History with a Modern Twist
creative_brief_summary.sales_hook: A rare opportunity to own a modern home within a historic landmark at a launch price advantage.
creative_brief_summary.visual_direction: Use real interior images to showcase the blend of historical and modern elements.
creative_brief_summary.composition_direction: Focus on the spacious, elegant living areas with a balance of historical and modern design elements.
creative_brief_summary.prompt_excerpt: Create a premium Instagram social advertisement BACKGROUND by editing the supplied project photograph, IH_DC_TMP_001_Render_Living_Room_003.jpeg. Focus on crafting a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere that highlights the blend of historical and modern elements within the living space. Maintain the integrity of the interior architecture, preserving the room geometry, windows, furniture layout, and materials exactly as they are. For the composition, use a SPLIT EDITORIAL approach on a 1080x1350 canvas. Position the building on the left, ensuring it occupies the left two-thirds of the image. Create a right-aligned editorial column with composed negative space in the right-upper type field. This area should be filled with ivory air, providing a quiet backdrop for the OS to typeset the headline, brand, and CTA. Enhance the visual balance by using rich, warm tones to reflect the historical aspect, complemented by modern accents for contrast. Incorporate architectural shadows and dusk lighting to add depth and sophistication. Ensure the right-hand editorial column is ready for OS to typeset with navy serif typography against the ivory air, maintaining high contrast. Do not rasterize any logos, wordmarks, slogans, addresses, prices, or CTAs into the image. Leave these areas clear for InvestHome OS to composite real files and exact strings. Focus on creating a luxurious real estate campaign atmosphere that conveys the project's unique offering: a modern home within a historic landmark at a launch price advantage
